## Type

- [ ] `feat:` — new behavior
- [ ] `fix:` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs:` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor:` / `chore:` — maintenance without behavior changes

## Validation

- [ ] `composer validate --strict`
- [ ] `composer lint`
- [ ] `composer test`
- [ ] Focused or regression test added, or N/A for documentation-only changes

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to its linked issue.
- [ ] Tests and documentation cover observable behavior.
- [ ] No speculative public API or unsupported browser capability was introduced.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials were committed.
- [ ] Repository-facing content is in English.
